name: Hydrogen SEO (Beta) – AI SEO, Meta Tags, Schema & Sitemap
author: Sheesh Labs AI

sections.description:
Hydrogen SEO is a lightweight, AI-powered SEO plugin for WordPress. It writes your meta titles and meta descriptions, generates schema markup, fills in image alt text, and audits your site for the on-page issues that hold rankings back — all from a fast, modern dashboard and directly inside the block editor.

It is built for how search works now. Alongside the metadata and structured data Google reads, it gives you an llms.txt editor and clean, machine-readable output, so the systems that answer questions from web content have something unambiguous to work from.

Hydrogen AI: an SEO agent inside your dashboard

Ask for what you want in plain language — “write meta descriptions for every post missing one”, “add FAQ schema to this page”, “find and fix broken internal links” — and Hydrogen AI does the work through the plugin’s own tools. It asks before anything it cannot undo, shows you every change it makes, and you can stop it at any point.

Hydrogen AI lives in two places: the plugin dashboard for site-wide work, and a tab in the editor’s SEO Settings sheet scoped to the post you are editing.

AI writing tools

  • AI meta titles and meta descriptions — click the AI button beside the field, get several suggestions with character counts, pick one and it fills the field
  • AI social titles and descriptions for Facebook / Open Graph and X (Twitter)
  • AI image alt text for a single image or in bulk across your media library
  • AI content generation and rewriting for SEO
  • AI featured image generation
  • AI-assisted schema (structured data) for your business details

On-page SEO essentials

  • SEO titles and meta descriptions with template variables for posts, pages, custom post types, taxonomies and archives
  • Schema markup (JSON-LD): Article, Product, FAQ, HowTo, Recipe, Course, Event, Local Business, Breadcrumbs and more
  • XML sitemaps
  • Robots meta controls per post, plus a built-in robots.txt editor
  • Open Graph and X (Twitter) card previews, so you see the share card before you publish
  • Google search result (SERP) preview as you type
  • Redirection manager with 301 and 302 support
  • Homepage SEO settings and canonical URLs

Built for AI search (AEO)

  • llms.txt editor — publish crawl and usage guidance for large language models, the emerging standard for AI answer engines
  • Structured data and metadata written to be machine-readable, so your pages are unambiguous to anything parsing them
  • Server-rendered output — nothing about your SEO depends on JavaScript running

Site audits and health checks

The dashboard scores your site across seven areas — crawlability, performance, mobile, security, content structure, schema markup and technical health — with a clear list of what to fix first. Site-wide audits find duplicate titles and descriptions, keyword cannibalisation, orphan pages, broken internal links and metadata that is too long or too short.

Fast and clean

  • Modern React dashboard
  • Heavy assets load on demand, so wp-admin stays quick
  • No front-end JavaScript and no extra front-end requests — the SEO output is server-rendered markup
  • Every screen is backed by the plugin’s own REST API

Free account for AI features

The AI features are powered by the Hydrogen SEO API. Create a free account at hydrogenseo.com, connect it from the plugin in one click, and you get free AI credits to start with.

Every non-AI SEO feature — titles, meta descriptions, schema, sitemaps, robots.txt, redirections, previews, audits — works with no account and no key.

Privacy

Hydrogen SEO adds no tracking, no analytics, no cookies and no front-end scripts. It does not phone home on a schedule. Nothing leaves your site until you use a feature that needs the Hydrogen SEO API.

Stored on your own site

  • Your Hydrogen SEO API key, in the WordPress options table
  • Your SEO settings, schema data, redirects and per-post metadata, in your own database
  • The agent connection details when Hydrogen AI is connected: the service URL, a site identifier and a service key
  • Nothing else. No visitor data, no personal data about your readers

Sent to the Hydrogen SEO API, only on your action

  • The text or image you ask an AI feature to work with — a topic, the content to improve, an image URL for alt text, a prompt for image generation, or your business details for schema
  • Your API key, to authorise and meter the request
  • For Hydrogen AI: your instructions, plus the SEO data of the pages it is working on
  • When you connect an account: your site URL, and the name and email you choose to give
  • When you connect Hydrogen AI: your site URL, your WordPress username, the application password described above, your WordPress version, the plugin version and the environment type (production, staging or local)

Application password handling

The application password the plugin mints for Hydrogen AI is transmitted over HTTPS and stored encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) by the Hydrogen SEO service, alongside a non-reversible fingerprint that only lets the interface confirm which credential is on file. Plain HTTP is refused for anything but local development hosts. If registration fails, the credential just created is deleted immediately rather than left on your account. Disconnecting, or revoking it in Users → Profile, ends that access.

The setup wizard

The wizard optionally asks for your name and email. If you fill them in and tick the consent checkbox, they are sent with your site URL so we can send you setup help and product updates. Both fields are optional, the wizard can be skipped, and nothing is sent if you leave them blank or do not consent.

AI processing

Generation is performed by the Hydrogen SEO API using AI model providers acting on its behalf, so the content of a request reaches those providers as part of producing your result. What is retained, and for how long, is set out in the privacy policy below.

Privacy policy: https://hydrogenseo.com/privacy
Terms of service: https://hydrogenseo.com/terms

External services

This plugin relies on the following third-party/external service. It is described here so you know what data is sent, when, and under which conditions.

Hydrogen SEO API

The plugin connects to the Hydrogen SEO API (hydrogenseo.com) for two things:

1. AI generation. Content generation and rewriting, metadata (SEO title and description) generation, image alt-text generation, AI image generation for featured images, and business/local schema generation.

Data is sent only when you actively use an AI feature. Depending on the feature the request includes the text or image you ask it to work with — a topic, the content to improve, an image URL for alt text, a prompt for image generation, or your business details for schema — together with your configured API key. When you connect your account, your site URL and the name and email you choose to provide are sent so an API key can be issued. The plugin does not send this data in the background or without a user action.

2. Hydrogen AI (the agent). When, and only when, you switch on AI Abilities and connect the agent, the plugin registers your site with the service. That registration sends your site URL, your WordPress username, a freshly created WordPress application password named “Hydrogen SEO Agent”, your WordPress version, the plugin version and your environment type, authenticated with your API key. The service verifies the credential by calling back into your site before storing it, keeps it encrypted (AES-256-GCM), and uses it to read and change SEO data on your behalf while you use the agent. Your instructions and the SEO data of the pages being worked on are sent as part of each conversation.

Agent access is gated three ways on your side: AI Abilities must be switched on, the abilities are locked to the domain they were enabled on, and only users with the manage_options capability can drive them. Disconnecting deletes the application password from your site; you can also revoke it from Users → Profile → Application Passwords at any time.

This service is provided by Hydrogen SEO. Terms of service: https://hydrogenseo.com/terms — Privacy policy: https://hydrogenseo.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Hydrogen SEO”, or upload the hydrogen-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Follow the short setup wizard
  4. To turn on the AI features, open Hydrogen SEO → API Key and connect your free hydrogenseo.com account
  5. To use Hydrogen AI, switch on AI Abilities and connect the agent — see the FAQ below for exactly what that creates and stores
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use the plugin?

No. SEO titles and meta descriptions, schema markup, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, redirections, social previews and the site health checks all work out of the box. Only the AI features — AI meta descriptions, alt text, content, images and Hydrogen AI — need a free API key from hydrogenseo.com.

Is Hydrogen SEO free?

The plugin is free and GPL licensed. The AI features run on the Hydrogen SEO API, which gives you free credits on signup; heavier use needs a paid plan. Nothing in the plugin stops working when you run out of credits — only the AI generation pauses.

How do the AI suggestions work in the editor?

Open the Hydrogen SEO panel while editing a post or page. Six fields have a small AI button beside them: the SEO title and meta description, the Open Graph title and description, and the X (Twitter) title and description. Click it and you get several suggestions with character counts. Choose one and it fills the field — you can still edit it afterwards, and nothing is published until you save.

What is Hydrogen AI and what can it change?

Hydrogen AI is a chat agent that reads and edits your site’s SEO through the plugin’s own registered tools: page metadata, structured data, sitemaps, robots rules, redirects, alt text and featured images. It runs under a policy you choose. By default it asks for confirmation before anything destructive, and you can set it to ask before every write or to run read-only checks. It cannot act at all until you switch on AI Abilities and connect it.

What is an application password, and why does Hydrogen AI need one?

Hydrogen AI runs on the Hydrogen SEO service, so the service needs a way to call back into your site to read and change SEO data. WordPress’s built-in application passwords are that mechanism — a revocable credential, separate from your login password, that never gives anyone access to your admin screens.

When you connect the agent, the plugin creates one application password named Hydrogen SEO Agent for the WordPress user doing the connecting, and sends it to the service over HTTPS so it can authenticate its calls back to your site. Any earlier credential with the same name is deleted first, so only one ever exists. The service verifies the credential by calling your site before it stores anything, and it stores it encrypted. See the “Privacy” and “External services” sections for the specifics.

How do I revoke the agent’s access?

Two ways, and either is enough:

  1. In the plugin, open Hydrogen SEO → Hydrogen AI and disconnect. The plugin deletes the Hydrogen SEO Agent application password from your site and clears the stored connection.
  2. In WordPress, go to Users → Profile → Application Passwords and revoke Hydrogen SEO Agent directly.

You can also switch AI Abilities off, which blocks every agent call at the gate regardless of any credential.

What is llms.txt and why does it matter?

llms.txt is a file at the root of your site that states how your content may be crawled and used by AI systems, in the way robots.txt does for search engines. It is a proposed convention, not a ratified standard, and honouring it is up to each crawler. Hydrogen SEO gives you an editor for it so the file exists and says what you want it to say.

How do I add schema markup without writing JSON-LD?

Pick a schema type in the Schema screen or in the post’s SEO panel and fill in the fields; the plugin outputs valid JSON-LD for you. Article, Product, FAQ, HowTo, Recipe, Course, Event, Local Business and Breadcrumbs are all supported, and the AI can draft your business details for you.

Is Hydrogen SEO compatible with other SEO plugins?

It works alongside other plugins, but running two SEO plugins that both output titles, meta tags or schema can produce duplicate output. For best results use Hydrogen SEO as your primary SEO plugin.

Will this slow my site down?

No. The plugin adds no front-end JavaScript for its SEO output, and the admin dashboard loads its heavy assets only when needed.

What are the requirements?

WordPress 6.7 or higher, PHP 7.4 or higher, and a modern browser with JavaScript enabled in the admin. Application passwords — needed only for Hydrogen AI — require HTTPS and must not be disabled by a security plugin.

Where is my data sent?

Only to the Hydrogen SEO API, and only when you actively use an AI feature or run the agent. The “External services” and “Privacy” sections below list exactly what is sent, when, and what is stored.
sections.changelog:
0.0.14

  • Smart tags everywhere: schema URL, date, number, textarea and image fields with dynamic defaults now use the variable editor (type @ to insert tags) in the dashboard and the editor
  • Fixed broken default tags and added the missing %author_url% variable; older saved values are migrated automatically
  • Date-time, telephone and email schema fields now render correctly (Event, Organization, Local Business and more)
  • One clean header: page description, page actions and a single Save button that appears only when there is something to save, plus an unsaved-changes prompt before leaving a page
  • Schema settings save on demand instead of auto-saving every edit
  • Steadier layout: one scroll container per page, pinned sidebar, lighter editor sheet that closes on outside click, compact social previews
  • Removed the placeholder Analytics, Instant Indexing and SEO Analyzer pages; Help & Support now opens the support site
  • Under the hood: 250+ automated tests, static analysis at maximum level and stricter coding standards across the plugin

0.0.13

  • Setup wizard is two steps instead of three: the Site Analysis step is gone, along with the scan endpoint behind it
  • Finishing setup now always records that it is complete, so the wizard stops reappearing after you leave the last screen

0.0.12

  • Hydrogen AI: a chat agent inside the plugin that reads and changes your site’s SEO through Hydrogen SEO’s own tools — page metadata, structured data, sitemaps, robots rules, redirects, alt text and featured images — and asks before anything it cannot undo
  • Hydrogen AI lives in the dashboard and as a second tab in the editor’s SEO Settings sheet, scoped to the post you are editing
  • 87 WordPress Abilities registered for agents, gated behind an explicit switch, a domain lock and the manage_options capability
  • New site-wide audits: duplicate titles and descriptions, keyword cannibalisation, orphan pages, broken internal links, metadata lengths
  • Connecting the agent needs only your Hydrogen SEO API key and confirms before creating its application password
  • The older per-field AI buttons, AI featured image section and AI tools page are retired in favour of Hydrogen AI

0.0.11

  • Onboarding improvements
  • Clearer consent wording and a working privacy policy link in the setup wizard

0.0.10

  • AI suggestions in the editor: the SEO title, meta description and social fields now have an AI button that offers several options with character counts — choose one and it fills the field
  • Fixed AI features that generated results but never applied or displayed them
  • Fixed AI requests timing out before the generation finished
  • Fixed AI featured image generation and setting a generated image as the featured image
  • Removed the AI Content Assistant panel in favour of the per-field AI buttons
  • Removed placeholder sample data from the dashboard so every number shown is your site’s own
  • Long generated text no longer overflows its input; added loading, empty and error states across the dashboard and the editor panel
  • Errors that previously failed silently (saving SEO settings, loading schema fields, content analysis) are now reported in the interface
  • Internal link suggestions are now provided by the separate Hydrogen SEO Pro add-on
  • Various layout, spacing and consistency fixes

0.0.9

  • Completely redesigned setup wizard with a new immersive look and a smoother step-by-step flow
  • Streamlined the WordPress admin menu — full navigation now lives inside the plugin dashboard’s own sidebar
  • Faster admin dashboard: heavy visual assets are now loaded on demand instead of up front
  • Fixed setup wizard layout issues: unnecessary scrolling, button placement, and focus states
  • Various UI polish and stability improvements across the dashboard and block editor

0.0.8

  • New Hydrogen SEO “Balloon” brand mark across the admin menu, dashboard, block editor, and WordPress.org listing (banner and icon)
  • Refreshed loading and onboarding animations to use the animated logo

0.0.7

  • Rebranded the plugin to Hydrogen SEO

0.0.6

  • Output JSON-LD schema markup with WordPress default escaping for safe script-context rendering
  • Registered plugin settings with a statically verifiable prefixed option name

0.0.3

  • Removed sitemap search-engine pinging and the XSL stylesheet
  • Documented external services in the readme
  • Sanitized stored schema data and escaped JSON-LD output for script context
  • Fixed General Settings not saving

0.0.1

  • Initial release
  • AI-powered content analysis
  • Content optimization features
  • Modern React-based dashboard
  • REST API integration
